description: The HP-95 Registration and Licensing Authority (R&LA) serves the Kumarsain subdivision within the Shimla district of Himachal Pradesh. This office manages vehicle registration, driving licenses, and other transport-related services to provide efficient administrative support for the Kumarsain region. It is part of the state's decentralization effort to bring transport services closer to citizens in hilly terrains.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Kumarsain, District Shimla, Himachal Pradesh
